verdict.rationale: Mastra offers a deployable Mastra Cloud platform, so transparent pricing and rate limits are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence contains no per-tool-call or per-connection prices and no documented rate limits. A community member also reports that Mastra's pricing page 'doesn't seem to list any prices' (mastra-comm-15), which points to the capability being absent rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
